2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Talbot will start vs. New Jersey on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Jet Greaves has struggled this season, resulting in Talbot playing more in recent weeks. The 39-year-old Talbot was serviceable in his most recent outing, saving 27 of 30 shots (.900 SV%), but lost 3-2 to the New Jersey Devils. In his last nine games (6-3-0), Talbot has a 2.42 GAA and a .918 SV%. The Blue Jackets enter Wednesday's game as +132 home underdogs in a rematch against the Devils, whose only win in their past four games was against the Blue Jackets (1-3-0).
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Hellebuyck will start in Columbus on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.awayNewsFantasyDetails: After being between the pipes for back-to-back Devils' losses, the first blips in Hellebuyck's tenure with his new team, he responded on Monday with a solid 19-save performance (.905 SV%), defeating the Columbus Blue Jackets 3-2. The 33-year-old American goalie has a 3.64 GAA and .884 SV% in his last five games (3-1-0). The Devils enter Wednesday's game as -146 road favourites in a rematch against the Blue Jackets, who are 6-6-0 at home this season.

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Markstrom will start vs. Ottawa on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Markstrom has had an up-and-down return to Florida, battling adversity in recent games, but he still managed a 4-3 win in his most recent game, despite allowing three goals on 19 shots (.842 SV%) against the Buffalo Sabres. The 36-year-old Swedish goalie has allowed three or more goals in five of seven November games (4-3-0), posting a pedestrian .892 SV%. The Panthers enter Wednesday's game as -117 home favourites against the red-hot Ottawa Senators, who have points in nine straight games (7-0-2).
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Ullmark will start vs. Florida on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Ullmark missed nearly three weeks with a lower-body injury, but hasn't missed a step since returning, continuing a tremendous start to the 2026-27 season. The 33-year-old Swedish goalie was tremendous in his most recent outing, saving 34 of 35 shots (.971 SV%) in a 2-1 win over the Calgary Flames. In 13 games this season (12-1-0), Ullmark has allowed more than two goals only once. The Senators enter Wednesday's game as slight +108 road underdogs against a Florida Panthers team they defeated 5-1 in their only matchup this season.

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Thompson will start vs. Philadelphia on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Over the past two seasons, Thompson quietly became one of the NHL's most consistent and reliable goalies, coming off consecutive 31-win campaigns. That said, the 29-year-old goalie has been flat-out unreliable through the quarter-mark of the 2026-27 season. In his most recent outing, Thompson didn't even last a full period, allowing three goals on five shots (.400 SV%) in an eventual 6-3 loss to the Buffalo Sabres. He has allowed three or more goals in all but five of 15 games this season (7-6-0). The Capitals enter Wednesday's game as -152 home favourites against a Philadelphia Flyers team on a three-game winning streak.
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Woll will start in Washington on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Woll is coming off arguably his worst performance of the season, allowing five goals on 21 shots (.808 SV%), but still managed a 6-5 overtime win over the Ottawa Senators. The 28-year-old American goalie is riding a season-best four-game winning streak, posting a 3.00 GAA and .875 SV%. The Flyers enter Wednesday's game as +140 road underdogs against the Washington Capitals, who beat them 5-2 less than a month ago but are currently on a four-game losing streak (0-4-0).

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Sorokin will start vs. St. Louis on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: After establishing himself as an elite goalie in his first three seasons, Sorokin has posted mid-pack statistics for three consecutive seasons. The 31-year-old goalie is off to a strong start in 2026-27, performing better under new Head Coach Pete DeBoer, but he suffered a 4-2 loss in his most recent outing, allowing three goals on 31 shots (.903 SV%) against the Toronto Maple Leafs. In November, Sorokin has a 2.47 GAA and .925 SV% in six games (3-1-2). The Islanders enter Wednesday's game as -117 home favourites against the St. Louis Blues, who have won four straight games.
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Hofer will start on Long Island on Wednesday.

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Silovs will start vs. Calgary on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: The Penguins have had a frustrating 2026-27 season in all areas, but Silovs has done little to aid his struggling team. That said, the 25-year-old Latvian goalie had a rare stellar performance in his most recent game, saving 22 of 23 shots (.957 SV%), but received no goal support in a 1-0 loss to the Dallas Stars. Silovs has lost six straight (0-5-1) and has allowed four or more goals in four of those games. The Penguins enter Wednesday's outing as -165 home favourites against the Calgary Flames, who have lost three straight (0-2-1).
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Wolf will start in Pittsburgh on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Before being sidelined with a lower-body injury, Devin Cooley owned the crease in Calgary, but he has struggled since returning. Meanwhile, Dustin Wolf seems to have found his game during Cooley's absence. That said, Wolf had an off night in his most recent outing, allowing four goals on 33 shots (.879 SV%) in a 4-3 overtime loss to the Chicago Blackhawks. The 25-year-old Wolf has a 2.50 GAA and .906 SV% in his last eight games (4-2-2). The Flames enter Wednesday's game as +146 road underdogs against a Pittsburgh Penguins team that has scored just six combined goals in their past four games (0-4-0).

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Swayman will start vs. Winnipeg on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Swayman had a tremendous start to the 2026-27 season, posting a stellar 1.85 GAA and .934 SV% in his first seven games (6-1-0). That said, the 28-year-old American goalie has battled some adversity in the weeks since, posting a subpar 3.24 GAA and .883 SV% in his last 10 games (5-4-1). Still, the Bruins enter Wednesday's game as -158 home favourites against a high-scoring Winnipeg Jets team that has scored four or more goals in nine of their last 10 games (8-1-1).
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Daws will start in Boston on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.awayNewsFantasyDetails: After being acquired by the Jets in a trade with the New Jersey Devils in late October, Daws saw limited action at the start of his tenure with his new team. That said, Daws has played well recently and will return to the crease for the fourth time in eight games. The 25-year-old German goalie has won three straight, posting a solid 2.17 GAA and .900 SV%. The Jets enter Wednesday's game as +151 road underdogs against a Boston Bruins team that has won two straight games.

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Vasilevskiy will start vs. Carolina on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Bussi will start in Tampa Bay on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Bussi had a surprising breakout last season as a 27-year-old rookie, ultimately leading the Hurricanes to a Stanley Cup Championship. However, early-season struggles and outstanding play from counterpart Pytor Kochetkov made Bussi a secondary option to start 2026-27. That said, Bussi has played better in recent weeks and earned more playing time. He has won three straight games, allowing three or fewer goals in each, and was excellent in his most recent outing, saving 25 of 27 shots (.926 SV%) in a 5-2 win over the New York Rangers. The Hurricanes enter Wednesday's game as slight -111 road favourites against the Tampa Bay Lightning, who are coming off a 6-2 loss to the Buffalo Sabres.

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Luukkonen will start in Buffalo on Thursday.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: After receiving unreliable goaltending from Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen and Colten Ellis, the Sabres were desperately awaiting Alex Lyon's debut in November after recovering from an injury. That said, Lyon has not been the answer, but Luukkonen has surprisingly elevated his game since. Luukkonen was stellar in his most recent outing, saving 29 of 31 shots (.935 SV%) in a 6-2 win over the Tampa Bay Lightning. The 27-year-old Finnish goalie has posted a SV% above .915 in four of his last five games (4-1-0). The Sabres enter Wednesday's game as -126 home favourites against the New York Rangers, who are coming off a 5-2 loss to the Carolina Hurricanes.
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Korpisalo will start vs. Buffalo on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Korpisalo hasn't played much since returning from a lower-body injury, making his debut in early November, but he has been solid when called upon. The 32-year-old Finnish goalie saved 24 of 25 shots (.960 SV%) in his most recent game, an impressive 3-1 win over the Montreal Canadiens. He has a 1.67 GAA and a .940 SV% in three games this season (3-0-0). The Rangers enter Wednesday's game as +116 road underdogs against the Buffalo Sabres, who are coming off an impressive 6-2 win over the Tampa Bay Lightning.

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Tarasov will start vs. Vancouver on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Tarasov has unexpectedly been getting more playing time in recent weeks, emerging as one of the NHL's most consistent goalies this season. That said, the 27-year-old goalie is coming off a 4-1 loss to the Boston Bruins, allowing three goals on 30 shots (.900 SV%). He hasn't received much goal support, as evidenced by a 1-4-0 record in his last five games, but he has an impressive 2.21 GAA and .927 SV% in those games.
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Merilainen led the Canucks onto the ice for warmups.
2026-11-25.awayNewsFantasyDetails: While Merilainen has been far from stellar this season, he remains the go-to option between the pipes for the Canucks, given the abysmal play of Kevin Lankinen. The 24-year-old Merilainen wasn't heavily tested in his most recent game, a rarity for a goalie on the defensively-porous Cancuks, saving 22 of 25 shots (.880 SV%) in a 4-3 shootout win over the Minnesota Wild. In seven November games (2-5-0), Merilainen has a 3.73 GAA and .876 SV%. The Canucks enter Wednesday's game as sizeable +196 road underdogs against the Detroit Red Wings, who have only scored five combined goals in their past three games (1-2-0).

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Wallstedt will start vs. Utah on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Wallstedt has deservedly been the busiest goalie in the NHL this season, playing 22 of 26 games, posting a tremendous 1.99 GAA and .924 SV% with a 16-2-4 record. The 24-year-old Swedish goalie has allowed three or fewer goals in all but three games this season. That said, Wallstedt could see a slight decrease in playing time after the season debut of Filip Gustavsson, who returned from hip surgery in Minnesota's previous game. Minnesota enters Wednesday's game as -142 home favourites against the Utah Mammoth, who have lost seven of their past nine games (2-4-3).
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Vejmelka will start Wednesday in Minnesota.

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Oettinger will start vs. Nashville on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: In just 18 games this season, Oettinger has already matched a career high with five shutouts, while no other goalie has more than two. The 27-year-old Oettinger was terrific in his most recent game, saving all 33 shots he faced in a 1-0 win over the Pittsburgh Penguins. In his last four games (4-0-0), Oettinger has a stellar 1.46 GAA and .946 SV%. The Stars enter Wednesday's game as -167 home favourites against the Nashville Predators, who are 8-2-0 in their past 10 games.
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Saros will start Wednesday in Dallas.

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Blackwood will start vs. Montreal on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Scott Wedgewood is coming off a shutout, arguably his first strong performance of the season, but Colorado will return to Blackwood, who has been their go-to guy all season. The 29-year-old Blackwood allowed three goals on 28 shots (.893 SV%) in his most recent outing, a 4-1 loss to the Utah Mammoth, but he has been dependable on most nights. Blackwood has allowed three or fewer goals in 13 consecutive games (9-2-1), posting a solid .915 SV%. The Avalanche enter Wednesday's game as slight -115 home favourites against a Montreal Canadiens team they defeated 4-1 earlier this month.
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Fowler will start in Colorado on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.awayNewsFantasyDetails: After a terrific start to the 2026-27 season, posting an impressive 1.54 GAA and .942 SV% in his first seven games (6-1-0), Fowler has been flirting with league averages since. In his last eight games (4-2-2), the 22-year-old American goalie has allowed four or more goals three times, posting a pedestrian 3.01 GAA and .897 SV%. The Canadiens enter Wednesday's game as slight +107 road underdogs against the Colorado Avalanche, who will welcome Cale Makar (lower body) back into their lineup from a two-week absence.

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Daccord led the Kraken onto the ice for warmups.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: In recent seasons, Daccord's strong play has made him the more reliable option in Seattle's crease, but the 2026-27 season has not been fruitful. That said, the 30-year-old Daccord was solid in Seattle's previous game, saving 24 of 26 shots (.923 SV%) in a 3-2 win over the Anaheim Ducks. In four November games (2-1-0), Daccord has an ugly 3.64 GAA and .868 SV%. The Kraken enter Wednesday's game as -150 home favourites against the Chicago Blackhawks, who are 4-1-1 in their past six games.
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Knight led the Blackhawks onto the ice for warmups.

2026-11-25.homeNewsDetails: Brossoit will start vs. San Jose on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Brossoit had a successful stint with the Ducks earlier this month, but was surprisingly sent down to San Diego (AHL) after a 4-2 loss to the Nashville Predators on November 11th, when he allowed four goals on 22 shots (.818 SV%). The 33-year-old Brossoit was far from spectacular this season, allowing three or more goals in four of five games, but he made timely saves and posted a solid 4-1-0 record. The Ducks enter Wednesday's game as -133 home favourites against a San Jose Sharks team coming off a 5-2 loss to the Minnesota Wild.
2026-11-25.awayNewsDetails: Nedeljkovic will start in Anaheim on Wednesday.
2026-11-25.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Yaroslav Askarov has struggled to keep the puck out of his net lately, so the Sharks will turn to Nedeljkovic, who has been serviceable in recent games. The 30-year-old Nedeljkovic has won two straight games, saving 60 of 65 combined shots (.923 SV%). The Sharks enter Wednesday's game as +120 road underdogs against the Anaheim Ducks, who are without two of their most potent offensive players, Beckett Sennecke (upper body) and Leo Carlsson (upper body).
